grader.scenario: TV channel guide showing 'No Information Available' across all channels; EPG cache rebuilt but full week requires background ingestion
grader.notes: Good call where agent was mostly polite and empathetic, resolving immediate guide issues, failing rapport for one rude remark and confirmed resolved due to background carousel download duration.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Neil throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand how distressing and heartbreaking that is for you and your father, Neil...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the EPG issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer account at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent flushed EPG cache, pushed IP metadata, verified immediate channels, and logged ticket.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you leave the TV box in standby mode instead of letting it run its nightly software maintenance cycles, you starve the guide of updates.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on channel 100 behavior and reboot outcomes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Current channels loaded but full 7-day guide required 3-4 hours to populate and could not be verified on call.
